newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans up in tight trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans up in tight trade.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans closed in tight trade Thursday as buyers finally appeared after a spate of falling prices, traders said.

FAS elevator soybeans rose $4 to $242 for delivery in Rosario. Supply was limited, with buyers reluctant to return to market. Cash maize also rose in low volume. Maize gained $2 for deliver to Buenos Aires to $99. Sunflower seed prices were bouyed by soybeans, rising $3 to $221 for delivery to Rosario in cash trade. Millers were paying $4 more for wheat in Buenos Aires at $146.
